summary: Frontend visual/functional test for Master Data Produk & Varian detail page (Endek Bali Rangrang, ptpl_c3546aeb9702d12ec9fb). All specified behaviors verified: hero image + facts (4 SKU, Rp 320.000 – Rp 345.000, 12 disetujui), 4 hero swatches, 4 variant cards with images and prices, selecting Merah Marun updates SKU/name correctly, media filter (mockup=1, all=4) works, media preview visible, Info tab shows description/spec (Bali Weave Studio, ENK-BALI-003) and 4 color chips + R&D policy button, R&D tab shows relations, sample count, and artwork image after switching to Ungu-Emas variant. Back navigation returns to product list with card showing '4 varian'. Mobile 390x844: no horizontal overflow, tabs clickable, variants stacked in single column.
